headline: JSE All Share up 1.2% to 114,083 by mid-afternoon as Brent drops 3.5% to $94.93 and the rand firms to R16.45/$
summary: In South Africa the JSE All Share was at 114,082.59 (+1.2% on Friday's close) and the Top 40 at 106,086.48 (+1.3%) at 14:44 SAST, with the rand at R16.45/$, 0.2% firmer (Yahoo Finance via LRC Market Dashboard, 9 Nov). Wall Street opens at 16:30 SAST; the S&P 500's last close was 7,376.86 on Friday, and US October CPI is due on Tuesday at 15:30 SAST (BLS schedule). Brent fell to $94.93, 3.5% below Friday's close, while gold held near $4,124 (+1.2%) and copper rose 1.7%, a mix that helps miners and should ease fuel-price pressure.

items.title: JSE All Share 114,082.59 (+1.2%), Top 40 106,086.48 (+1.3%) at 14:44 SAST
items.summary: Both indices extended last week's gains (All Share +4.8% in the week to 6 November). Friday closes were 112,739.40 and 104,714.00. Higher gold and copper prices support the miners in the Top 40.
